products.name: French Tortoise Shell Jumbo Claw Clip
products.description: Handcrafted with premium cellulose acetate for exceptional durability and a sleek, glossy sheen. Features custom double-teeth interlocking grip that holds thick, medium, and fine hair effortlessly without snagging or pulling.
details: Material: Bio-acetate cellulose with gold-plated internal spring
Length: 10.5 cm (Jumbo size for full up-dos)
Grip: Rounded teeth for painless all-day comfort
products.materials: High-grade cellulose acetate with reinforced steel coil spring.
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean with a soft dry cloth. Keep away from direct high heat or harsh chemicals.

products.name: Gilded Blossom Floral Metal Hair Claw
products.description: Exquisitely sculpted in hollow-relief gold finish metal, inspired by vintage botanical motifs. Lightweight yet remarkably strong, adding a royal touch to festive festive wear and everyday buns alike.
details: Finish: Premium anti-tarnish champagne gold electroplating
Perfect for: Half-up styles, French twists, and festive occasions
products.materials: Zinc alloy core with anti-tarnish brushed gold plating.
products.careInstructions: Store in moisture-free pouch. Avoid spraying hairspray or perfume directly on the clip.

products.name: Pure Mulberry Silk Skinny Scrunchie Trio
products.description: Set of 3 slender scrunchies crafted from 100% pure 22-momme grade 6A mulberry silk. Eliminates ponytail ridges, prevents cuticle friction, and locks in natural hair hydration overnight and through busy work days.
details: Includes 3 shades: Champagne Cream, Dusty Rose, and Midnight Burgundy
Wide internal elastic core prevents stretching out over time
Zero hair breakage, zero tension headaches
products.materials: 100% Pure Mulberry Silk (22 Momme).
products.careInstructions: Hand wash in cold water with mild shampoo or silk detergent. Air dry flat in shade.

products.name: Organza Cloud Oversized Ruffle Scrunchie
products.description: Dreamy, ethereal oversized scrunchie made of gossamer-light textured organza with delicate pearl droplet accent. Creates instant drama and romantic volume on any ponytail or topknot.
details: Features a subtle dangling freshwater seed pearl charm
products.materials: Featherlight sheer organza and faux pearl pendant.
products.careInstructions: Gently spot clean with cool damp cloth.

products.name: Royal Padded Velvet Crown Headband
products.description: Elevate your hair game with our signature padded headband wrapped in plush micro-velvet. Designed with flexible comfort-arch tips behind the ears for zero-pinch, all-day wearing pleasure.
details: Width: 3.5 cm padded arch tapering to 2 cm at base
Flexible lightweight inner band fits all head shapes comfortably
Seamless edges with grooved inner grip lining
products.materials: Micro-velvet fabric over soft foam padding and flexible resin core.
products.careInstructions: Brush lightly with a velvet brush or lint roller. Do not immerse in water.

products.name: Baroque Pearl Embellished Arch Headband
products.description: Lustrous multi-sized ivory baroque pearls individually wire-wound onto a woven gold ribbon band. Adds instant royal bridal elegance to lehengas, sarees, and cocktail dresses.
details: Hand-threaded graduated faux pearls with crystal seed accents
Satin-wrapped end comfort cushions for sensitive ears
products.materials: Graduated baroque acrylic pearls, brass craft wire, satin ribbon.
products.careInstructions: Store in protective jewelry box to avoid scratching pearls.

products.name: Handcrafted Pearl & Gold Hair Pin Trio
products.description: A charming set of three complementary hairpin styles: single statement baroque pearl pin, branchlet crystal pin, and textured beaded cluster bobby pin. Perfect for tucking into messy buns or braids.
details: Set of 3 distinct matching hair pins
Sturdy 6.5 cm wave-grip bobby pin bases that stay firmly put
Hand-wired flexible branches can be shaped to suit your hair
products.materials: Faux glass pearls, faceted Czech crystals, gold-finished alloy pins.
products.careInstructions: Keep dry. Wipe gently with jewelry cloth after wear.

products.name: Gilded Leaf & Crystal Floral Hair Vine
products.description: A 28cm flexible bridal hair vine adorned with hand-painted gold leaf filigree, pearlescent petals, and sparkling marquise crystals. Can be woven into bridal braids, wrapped around chignons, or pinned as a forehead tiara.
details: Length: 28 cm bendable wire vine with end pin-loops
Includes 2 gold bobby pins and ivory satin ribbon ties
Feather-light and customizable to any wedding or festive hairstyle
products.materials: Flexible tarnish-resistant jewelry wire, brass leaves, Austrian crystals.
products.careInstructions: Store flat in original box.

products.name: Pastel Blossom Kids' Snap Clip Set (Pack of 6)
products.description: Designed specially for delicate young hair. Six sweet grosgrain-wrapped snap clips featuring miniature daisy blossoms, soft gingham bows, and tiny pastel clouds. Gentle hold that does not pull baby hairs.
details: Fully fabric-encased clips for maximum scalp safety and comfort
products.materials: Lead-free metal core covered in 100% cotton fabric and felt blossoms.
products.careInstructions: Hand wash surface lightly with damp sponge.

products.name: Shimmer Butterfly Mini Barrettes (Set of 4)
products.description: Four sparkling double-winged flutter butterfly clips in soft sugar-shimmer pastel tones. The wings gently flutter as little girls walk and play!
details: Alligator clip with silicone non-slip teeth grip
Glitter is sealed and does not shed on clothes or skin
products.materials: Laser-cut mesh organza with sealed eco-glitter on nickel-free alloy.
products.careInstructions: Keep in dry case when not in use.

products.name: Matte Pastel Buttercup Medium Hair Claw
products.description: Velvety soft-touch rubberized matte finish in calming cottagecore pastel hues. The medium 8.5 cm profile is ideal for everyday half-up buns and quick errands.
products.materials: Shatter-resistant acrylic with soft matte rubberized finish.
products.careInstructions: Rinse with clean water and pat dry.

products.name: Champagne Satin Tail Bow Hair Tie
products.description: A pre-tied graceful Parisian ribbon bow with flowing 18 cm drape tails, secured to a heavy-duty seamless elastic tie. Instantly transforms a simple low ponytail into effortless runway elegance.
details: Tail length: 18 cm flowing fluid drape
Double-sided satin with high-density weave that resists creasing
Reinforced center knot that never comes undone
products.materials: Heavyweight silk-satin blend.
products.careInstructions: Steam lightly if folded during shipping. Hand wash cool.

products.name: Royal Kundan Meenakari Choker Necklace
products.description: Exquisite handcrafted bridal choker necklace featuring traditional Meenakari enamel artistry, luminous imitation glass pearls, and micro-plated antique gold finish. A timeless statement piece for weddings and festive evenings.
details: Costume & Fashion Jewellery — Non-precious alloy with gold-tone finish
Adjustable soft zari drawstring closure fits all neck circumferences comfortably
products.materials: High-grade brass alloy with gold-toned lacquer plating, synthetic stones, imitation glass pearls, cotton-zari dori.
products.careInstructions: Fashion jewellery: Store in an airtight container or zip lock bag. Avoid contact with perfumes, hairspray, and direct moisture.

reviews.author: Ayesha M.
reviews.comment: The quality of the French Tortoise Shell claw is unbelievable! I have very thick, long hair that breaks normal plastic clips, but this clip holds my entire bun firmly all day with zero headaches. Truly boutique quality!
reviews.productName: French Tortoise Shell Jumbo Claw Clip

reviews.author: Priyanka Sharma
reviews.comment: I ordered the Gilded Blossom metal claw and the velvet padded headband for my sister’s engagement. The packaging was so thoughtfully done in cream and gold, and the shine on the metal is stunning. 10/10 recommendation!
reviews.productName: Gilded Blossom Floral Metal Hair Claw

reviews.author: Sneha Patel
reviews.comment: Bought the kids snap clips for my 4-year-old daughter. She normally hates hairpins, but these are so gentle and soft with fabric padding. Plus the floral pastel designs are so chic and sweet!
reviews.productName: Pastel Blossom Kids' Snap Clip Set

reviews.author: Fatima Z.
reviews.comment: The Mulberry Silk scrunchies are genuine silk! My hair has zero dents when I take it off in the morning. Fast delivery and the WhatsApp team was so helpful in helping me select shades.
reviews.productName: Pure Mulberry Silk Skinny Scrunchie Trio
